summary: Shorter install commands, and Invardia sees the true state of every setup step.

fixes.title: Invardia sees the true setup state
fixes.text: Invardia's install view now shows the true state of every one-time setup step instead of unknown.

fixes.title: Shorter install commands
fixes.text: The second install line carries only the tenant, subscription, region and the options you actually chose.

fixes.title: Private installs check DNS zones first
fixes.text: A private-network install checks every private DNS zone it needs before it creates anything, and names all missing ones at once.

fixes.title: Running the installer twice works
fixes.text: Running the installer twice in the same PowerShell window no longer fails; it signs in again.

fixes.title: Cleaner release package
fixes.text: Every release package from Invardia is checked before it is published.
